mudasobwa. According to the 1st Kinyarwanda-English Dictionary called "IRIZA-STARTER 2006" compiled by Rural ICT-Net, The coined word "mudasobwa" for a computer appears in the poem "Imanzi yanyuze u Rwanda" on the 25th anniversary of Mgr Aloys Bigirumwami's priesthood (It was o n the 25 July 1976) where it says: "Ubwo ari Nkoni iragiye Nyundo Uracyure impenda iyo zagenewe, Ubwo uri Mudasobwa ntusobanure intama, Uraturagire inkome dukomere ku Mana, Komeza kudushora amariba adakama Nkumburwa ya Nkomejekurinda."
